# Tradeforge

> Tradeforge is an Australian job aggregator platform specialising in trade, construction, and FIFO mining positions, collecting and organizing job listings from multiple sources across major Australian cities and territories.

Tradeforge aggregates job listings from various job boards and employer websites, providing a centralized search platform for trade professionals. The platform focuses on key trades including electricians, plumbers, carpenters, welders, and mining professionals, with special emphasis on FIFO positions.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.tradeforge.com.au): Main entry point with job search functionality and featured positions
- [Blog](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/blog): Industry insights and career guidance
- [FIFO Guide](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/blog/how-to-get-a-fifo-job-in-australia-2025): Comprehensive guide to FIFO work in Australia

## Job Categories

- [FIFO Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo): Fly-in fly-out positions across Australia
- [Construction Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/construction): Construction industry positions
- [Mining Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/mining): Mining sector opportunities
- [Electrician Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/electrician): Licensed electrician positions
- [Plumber Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/plumber): Qualified plumber roles
- [Carpenter Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/carpenter): Carpentry positions
- [Truck Driver Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/truck-driver): Transport and logistics roles
- [FIFO Mining](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo-mining): Specialized FIFO mining positions
- [Welder Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/welder): Welding opportunities
- [Bricklayer Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/bricklayer): Bricklaying positions
- [Painter Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/painter): Painting roles
- [Roofer Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/roofer): Roofing positions
- [Scaffolder Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/scaffolder): Scaffolding work
- [Concreter Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/concreter): Concreting positions
- [Labourer Jobs](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/labourer): General labour positions

## Major Locations

- [New South Wales](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/nsw): Sydney, Newcastle
- [Victoria](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/vic): Melbourne
- [Queensland](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/qld): Brisbane, Gold Coast
- [Western Australia](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/wa): Perth
- [South Australia](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/sa): Adelaide
- [Tasmania](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/tas): Hobart
- [Australian Capital Territory](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/act): Canberra
- [Northern Territory](https://www.tradeforge.com.au/jobs/fifo/nt)
